retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1980s-style collage featuring airbrushed gradients, jagged paper cut-outs, and a central minimalist line-art figure.
triggerTerms: minimalist line art profile with bold outlines

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition centered on a white, minimalist line-art figure set against a chaotic, multi-colored airbrushed background with jagged, hand-cut paper text elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Central white figure acts as a visual anchor against a busy background
Jagged paper cutouts frame the top and bottom of the composition
Airbrushed gradients provide depth behind flat, graphic foreground elements
Bold black outlines unify disparate collage textures
coreInvariants: Jagged, irregular white paper borders around all text elements
Airbrushed red-to-black gradient at the top margin
Minimalist, continuous-line style for the central character's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, white abstract figure occupies the center, spanning roughly 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white figure with bold black outlines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top arched text, move down to the central figure, and finish at the bottom jagged text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with patterns, though the white figure provides a large area of visual rest.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary Red, Blue, and Yellow (background patterns and text accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background patterns contrasted with a stark white central subject.
paletteRestrictions: Heavy use of black for outlines

letterConstructionRules: Letters are drawn with a thick marker style
Red drop-shadow or offset stroke on top text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly slanted and vary in thickness
The 'i' in the bottom text uses a lowercase form while others are uppercase

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the head of the figure

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent hand-drawn marker style across all text elements but with different color accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, hand-drawn stroke quality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant 80s airbrush background with red-to-black gradients at the top, blue and yellow abstract shapes, and black polka dot patterns. Place a large, minimalist white figure with a bold black outline in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn marker-style text on top and bottom. Each word should be contained within a jagged, hand-cut white paper shape. The top text should be arched with a red offset stroke.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within jagged white paper cutouts?
Is the background airbrushed with visible gradients?
Is the central figure a minimalist white shape with a bold black outline?
Does the top text follow an arched path?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the central line-art figure
Degree of jaggedness in the paper cutouts
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figure
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly horizontal or vertical
Check that the white figure remains the brightest element
Verify the presence of the red-to-black airbrush at the top
Confirm the 'cut-out' edges look irregular and hand-torn
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Airbrushed Abstract Background] + [Minimalist White Line-Art Subject] + [Jagged Paper Cut-out Typography] to create a 1980s neo-expressionist collage.
